# Font Awesome Free 6.4.0

The hardware portal homepage uses the vendored Solid icon font so its critical
rendering path does not depend on an external CDN.

- Upstream: `@fortawesome/fontawesome-free` 6.4.0
- Included: `fontawesome.min.css`, `solid.min.css`, `fa-solid-900.woff2`
